title: The Army That Lost a War to Birds #shorts

lines.text: An army rolled out machine guns to fight a bunch of birds.
The general said it would take a week, tops.
A month later, the birds were winning,
and nobody could figure out why.

sources: Wikipedia, 'Emu War': in late 1932 Australian soldiers with Lewis machine guns were sent to cull emus damaging wheat in Western Australia; the first attempt (from 2 November) was withdrawn on 8 November, a second ran from 13 November to 10 December with poor results; the emus scattered into small groups and outran the trucks
